'''2023 Online Retro Event''' was the Players Committee Premiere–Special Edition retro event on GEMP, April–June 2023. [[Timo Dusel]] finished 1st.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2023-06-annual-online-retro-event-premiere-special-edition-april-june-2023/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]]
* '''Site:''' GEMP
* '''Dates:''' April–June 2023
* '''Winner:''' [[Timo Dusel]]
* '''GEMP importable decks:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=83197 forum]
